desc: The PMAG 35 EV9 9mm, 35rd for the CZ Scorpion EVO 3. The PMAG 35 EV9 provides round stack geometry, giving the large format pistol, PCC and SMG market a pistol caliber magazine with Magpul reliability and increased magazine capacity. It features indicator windows at 10, 20, 30 and 35-round intervals.
